environment.description: Jenkins CI server running the plugin as a freestyle build step. The plugin process runs as the 'jenkins' user with read access to /var/log/pipeline which is consumed by Splunk forwarder for security alerting. The Splunk forwarder parses log lines and triggers alerts based on patterns like '[ERROR]' or specific stage names. No filesystem isolation is applied to the plugin process.

config.filesystem: unrestricted, shared /var/log/pipeline with Splunk Universal Forwarder
config.log_consumer: Splunk UF with props.conf parsing [timestamp] [level] [stage] pattern
config.network: internal CI network with access to artifact stores and deployment targets
